message: S30 peril severity trends and contents ensemble; ultimate risk estimate

local_validation.method: Frozen N48 full Tweedie 1.5 paired comparison vs original S22, reused V23 selection and V24; 72 scopes/reserves and fixed cluster diagnostics. Saved-component assembly replay separately verified.

availability_scope: Delivered separate B recipe reuses saved main-line F0/F1/F2/F4 and home F3 components. Historical master-date and F3 availability limitations persist; not fully prospective raw-feature availability certification. No own A_G annual-weather producer or marketing head imported.
weather_scope: S30 contains no S31 annual-2025 weather anomaly increment. Existing source feature availability limits retained; no attribution of public change to climate, reserve adequacy or a particular peril.
validation_limits: Automatic N48 improvement gate FAILED: gain below 0.0002, conditional CIs include zero and adverse line/semester/reserve points.
New specific human N56 request authorizes only this controlled comparative trial; not statistical promotion.
V23/V24 and public results reused for author selection: not independent validation.
V23 buildings and V24 contents/H2 adverse; ten favorable customers exceed net nominal gain in author fixed-denominator influence diagnostic.
Trend estimates may confound development, mix and inflation; one reserve valuation does not identify IBNER or unbiased reserves.
Saved-component assembly replay does not repeat every raw base-model inference or training.
No expected public score or sampling-error band inferred from local CV.
ultimate_level: Ultimate expected cost under the delivered historical development assumptions; s17 level rule extended to B runs, motor shape 1.09/0.95, contents exposure elasticity 0.95, buildings identity. No extra IBNR added.
authorization: Direct human N56 request explicitly asks to test S30 now. Controlled comparative trial despite failed N48 statistical qualification, negative conditional lower bounds and adverse segments. Prior clear-improvement gate remains unchanged for other candidates. Integrity, assembly replay, live quota, dryrun and duplicate checks required. No independent validation, expected public score or manual final selection implied.
